title: Entity Ranged Attack Behavior
description: Allows an entity to attack by using ranged shots. "charge_shoot_trigger" must be greater than 0 to enable charged up burst-shot attacks. Requires minecraft:shooter to define projectile behaviour.

attack_interval.title: Attack Interval
attack_interval.description:
Reload-time range (in seconds), when not using a charged shot. Reload-time range scales with target-distance.

Sample values:
• bogged: 3.5
• bogged: 2.5
attack_interval.x-runtime-constraint-description: Check that the limits imposed on the range (minimum, maximum and maximum distance between values) are respected

attack_radius.title: Attack Radius
attack_radius.description:
Minimum distance to target before this entity will attempt to shoot.

Sample values:
• blaze: 48
• bogged: 15
• drowned: 10

attack_radius_min.title: Attack Radius Min
attack_radius_min.description: Minimum distance the target can be for this mob to fire. If the target is closer, this mob will move first before firing

burst_interval.title: Burst Interval
burst_interval.description:
Time (in seconds) between each individual shot when firing a burst of shots from a charged up attack.

Sample values:
• blaze: 0.3

burst_shots.title: Burst Shots
burst_shots.description:
Number of shots fired every time the attacking entity uses a charged up attack.

Sample values:
• blaze: 3

charge_charged_trigger.title: Charge Charged Trigger
charge_charged_trigger.description:
Time (in seconds, then add "charge_shoot_trigger"), before a charged up attack is done charging. Charge-time decays while target is not in sight.

Sample values:
• llama: 1

charge_shoot_trigger.title: Charge Shoot Trigger
charge_shoot_trigger.description:
Amount of time (in seconds, then doubled) a charged shot must be charging before reloading burst shots. Charge-time decays while target is not in sight.

Sample values:
• blaze: 4
• llama: 2

priority.title: Priority
priority.description:
As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

Sample values:
• blaze: 3
• llama: 2
• parched: 1

ranged_fov.title: Ranged Fov
ranged_fov.description: Field of view (in degrees) when using sensing to detect a target for attack.

set_persistent.title: Set Persistent
set_persistent.description: Allows the actor to be set to persist upon targeting a player

speed_multiplier.title: Speed Multiplier
speed_multiplier.description: During attack behavior, this multiplier modifies the entity's speed when moving toward the target.

swing.title: Swing
swing.description:
If a swing animation (using variable.attack_time) exists, this causes the actor to swing their arm(s) upon firing the ranged attack.

Sample values:
• drowned: true

target_in_sight_time.title: Target In Sight Time
target_in_sight_time.description: Minimum amount of time (in seconds) the attacking entity needs to see the target before moving toward it.

x_max_rotation.title: x Max Rotation
x_max_rotation.description: Maximum rotation (in degrees), on the X-axis, this entity can rotate while trying to look at the target.

y_max_head_rotation.title: y Max Head Rotation
y_max_head_rotation.description: Maximum rotation (in degrees), on the Y-axis, this entity can rotate its head while trying to look at the target.

attack_interval_max.title: Attack Interval Max
attack_interval_max.description:
Maximum bound for reload-time range (in seconds), when not using a charged shot. Reload-time range scales with target-distance.

Sample values:
• blaze: 5
• drowned: 3

attack_interval_min.title: Attack Interval Min
attack_interval_min.description:
Minimum bound for reload-time range (in seconds), when not using a charged shot. Reload-time range scales with target-distance.

Sample values:
• blaze: 3
• drowned: 1
